sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The graph omits the explicit obligation to use draught-dependent inputs at the corresponding UIWL/LIWL draught and to use L and B measured at UIWL for both calculations; merely requiring UIWL/LIWL strings does not encode those operand relationships. Locate the canonical terms for L, B, and the required draught/provenance relationships, then bind and validate them in the bounded formula calculation. Also prevent missing constructionStageDate or iceClass from silently satisfying the non-applicable sh:or branch; require sufficient applicability evidence before applying the date/class gate.
